blocks.text: Leviticus 21 contains 24 verses. It opens with: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none defile himself for the dead among his people; It concludes with: So Moses spake unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Leviticus moves from sacrifice and priestly inauguration through purity and the Day of Atonement into instructions for holy communal life, sacred time, land, covenant consequences, and vows.
